svg.title: OBSERVABILITY LAB
svg.desc: Express observability lab: an Express CRUD API instrumented with prom-client (request counter and latency histogram by method, route and status) and winston-loki logs; Prometheus, Grafana and Loki run from Docker Compose. Animated packets flow from Express to Prometheus and Loki and on to Grafana. The histogram is illustrative only, with no real values.
